scientific_motivation.question: Can parameter-efficient adaptation learn from the broad teacher corpus while preserving more of the base model's general behavior than full-weight tuning?
scientific_motivation.intentional_difference: The candidate uses rank-64 all-linear LoRA with its qualified 3e-5 learning rate; the comparator updates full weights at 3e-6. This is a method comparison, not a literal one-hyperparameter ablation.
scientific_motivation.not_a_sweep: This is the already production-qualified LoRA anchor, not an additional learning-rate variant.

preparation_location.supported: cyber-post-train train may write the immutable prepared directory to any new local writable directory. It does not need an SFS mount.
preparation_location.forbidden: The prepared directory must not be the training output root, and a missing local /mnt/sfs mount must not be worked around by making a fake SFS directory.

remote_preparation_boundary.reason: pod-publish-file only atomically copies one file into an already-running CPU Pod. It neither creates a LoRA CPU preflight Pod nor produces the required PREFLIGHT.json.
remote_preparation_boundary.required_response: Do not hand-write a Pod, fabricate PREFLIGHT.json, or treat a transferred archive as a preflight. Use an authorized SFS-mounted preflight host, or land a separately reviewed remote-preflight feature before attempting this launch.

allowed_only_if: the live preview has no warnings or errors
the rendered root RayJob, not only a Pod template, contains fleet.ai/failure-alerts: off
the rendered priority remains c1 and the request remains one worker with eight GPUs

proofs_the_command_requires: a Kubernetes API-server dry-run whose root RayJob has fleet.ai/failure-alerts: off
a durable create intent before exactly one kubectl create
sft_only_fallback_when_normal_preview_om.scope_limit: Use only the maintained SFT fallback. Do not hand-render, patch, or extend it to RL or conversion work.

pre_create_checklist: Render this exact config into a new local writable prepared directory that is different from the training output root: cyber-post-train train configs/runs/qwen38-27b-lora-sft-r64-a32-anchor-v1.json --output <prepared-directory>.
Run the pinned-image CPU-only preflight against the staged model and corpus. It must write a fresh PREFLIGHT.json for this prepared directory.
Check the live capacity census and confirm that adding one eight-GPU c1 node remains within the project limit.
Run the generic Jobs API preview first. Do not rely on failureAlerts: false in the request without proof from the root RayJob render.
If normal preview proves the root annotation, use normal submit; otherwise use only the SFT-only direct fallback above after its server dry-run proof.

Immediately before create, repeat output-absence and duplicate checks. If the submitter lacks the shared mount, create and collect exactly one fresh zero-GPU SFS observer receipt and consume it within five minutes.
Create once only. Any uncertain create response requires read-only reconciliation, never a duplicate name or retry.
hard_stop_conditions: missing or noncanonical root fleet.ai/failure-alerts annotation
an existing training output, matching Jobs API run, or matching Kubernetes object
a preview, dry-run, image, source, resource, or Secret-reference mismatch
